'''''Thesium''''' is a genus of [[flowering plant]]s in the family [[Santalaceae]]. It is particularly well represented in [[South Africa]],<ref>{{cite journal |author=[[John Patrick Micklethwait Brenan|J. P. M. Brenan]] |year=1979 |title=Three new species of ''Thesium'' (Santalaceae) from South Africa |journal=[[Kew Bulletin]] |volume=33 |issue=3 |pages=395–397 |doi=10.2307/4110134 |jstor=4110134|bibcode=1979KewBu..33..395B }}</ref> where roughly half the species occur.<ref name=":0">{{Cite Q|Q134238027}}</ref> Nickrent and others argue that the genera ''Austroamericium'' Hendrych, ''Chrysothesium'' (Jaub. & Spach) Hendrych, ''[[Kunkeliella]]'' Stearn, and ''Thesidium'' Sond should be considered as part of this genus.<ref name=":0" />

Species in this genus are parasitic on roots.<ref name=":0" /> Fruits of ''Thesium'' species are nutlike [[Achene|achenes]].<ref name=":0" />

The following species are recognised by ''[[The Plant List]]'':<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.theplantlist.org/1.1/browse/A/Santalaceae/Thesium/ |title=''Thesium'' |publisher=[[The Plant List]] |accessdate=14 February 2016}}</ref>
